types.name: Nit
types.description: Plays very few hands, rarely bluffs, gives up easily without a strong hand.

types.name: Calling Station
types.description: Plays many hands passively and calls far too often; hard to bluff.

types.name: Maniac
types.description: Plays many hands very aggressively: raises, 3-bets and barrels with a wide range.

types.name: Overfolder
types.description: Reasonably tight preflop but folds too often to c-bets and pressure.

types.name: Reg
types.description: Solid regular with standard frequencies; no big leak to target.
